clusters.mechanism: The orphan fallback treats any hidden process born during the invocation with a cwd under the invocation directory as owned by it, so shutdown kills unrelated processes.

Discovery relies on environment markers, cwd and ancestry, so detached descendants that replace their environment and leave the invocation directories escape it, and shutdown reports success while they stay alive.
The second checkoutCommitted call after a gate timeout omits retryClean, so a transient clean failure is thrown as a CommandError instead of being treated as a failed implement round.
